tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dzaṃ dkar rjes gnang khams gsum dbang sdud bzhugs so// na mo gu ru lo kī shwa ra dzam+bha la ye/ thugs rje'i dbang phyug 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /'gro ba'i dbul phongs sdug bsngal sel ba'i phyir/ /'dod dgu'i 'byung khungs ār+ya dzam+bha la/ /dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ /gang gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang cho gar bcas/ /'khrul med dam pa gong ma'i gzhung bzang bzhin/ /rang dang skal mnyam don du gsal bar bshad/ /yar ngo'i dus bzang bkra shis par/ /dben pa'i gnas su stegs kyi khar/ /maṇ+ḍal sna tshogs pad+ma'i dbus/ /tshom bu dkar dang phyogs bzhi ru/ /shar sngo lho ser nub dmar dang / /byang du ljang ba'i tshom bu bkod/ /zlum gtor chu gnyis nyer mchod dang / /dbang rdzas kha ṭ+wāṃ ka be con/ /rdo rje bcud snod nor bu bum/ /pad+ma lcags kyu rgya gram dang / /ne'u le'i rkyal pa la sogs pa/ /'bur dang bris pa gang rung bshams/ /rdo dril me tog maṇ+ḍal dang / /gu gul la sogs slob ma la/ /dgos chas tshang ma 'du bya'o/ /mchod pa rnams a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lha rdzas kyi mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gi bar so so'i phyag rgya bcas pa'i mthar dril gsil ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇis byin gyis brlabs/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar byas la/ rang skad cig gis dzam+bha lar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dzam+bha la la bla ma 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥpad+ma kro dha at+ma dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥs phyag bya/ gang gi sngags gsham du ar+ghaṃ sogs btags nas mchod/

gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ dngos gzhi ni/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid dzaṃ dkar po/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can rnams kyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa dzam+bha la sku mdog gangs ri'i mdog ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum la chags pa'i nyams can/ yid tsam khros pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra dkar ser gyen du brdzes shing / sma ra dang smin ma dkar ser gyen du 'khyil ba/ phyag g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dang / g.yon rin po che'i be con bsnams pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ se mo do/ 'og pags/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub rnams kyis spras shing / dar gyi yug gon stod g.yogs kyi tshul du 'phyang zhing / pañtsa li ka'i sham thabs can/ g.yu 'brug gi steng na zhabs gnyis phyed skyil gyi tshul du bzhugs pa de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla gdan la dzaṃ dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba/ de las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dzam+bha la dkar po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par bstims/ slar yang 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa ma ཱdzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyi mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas mchod/

shel dkar zhun ma'i phung po dbang gzhu yis/ /rab dkris gar dgu'i nyams ldan gnod sbyin dbang / /'dod dgu'i dngos grub char ltar 'bebs mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan dzam+bha la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying khar zla ba'i gdan la dzaṃ yig dkar po'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ khyad par khams gsum gyi dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad bsdus te ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub thob par bsams la/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la hrī da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ji ltar rigs pa bzlas la/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra re re 'gor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma las/ /'dod dgu'i dpal ster rab brjid gnod sbyin dbang / /dbul phongs sdug bsngal kun sel nor gyi lha/ /mgon po dzam+bha la la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bcom ldan 'das mgon po dzam+bha las bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi ma dag pa'i 'tshe ba spangs nas chos dang mthun pa'i 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la longs spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang sh+lau ka gcig gi mthar/ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs par bsam/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge dzaṃ dkar po zhes pa nas/ bzhugs pa'i bar gong bzhin/ shar du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon rten 'brel gyi snod/ lhor traṃ las rin po che traṃ gyis mtshan pa las rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo g.yas nor bu/ g.yon bum pa/ nub tu paṃ las pad+ma paṃ gyis mtshan pa las pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo g.yas pad+ma/

g.yon lcags kyu/ byang du khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang khu g.yas rgya gram/ g.yon ne'u le'i rkyal pa bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig spyan gsum ma/ dbu skra ser po'i thor tshugs can/ dar dang rin po che'i brgyan pa g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i/ dpral bar oṃ zhes pa nas dkar po'i bar gong bzhin la/ rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i zhes sbyar nas/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la 'od dpag med/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la mi bskyod pa/ rin chen mkha' 'gro la rin chen 'byung ldan/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro la 'od dpag med/ las kyi mkha' 'gro la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin gyis rlabs nas mchod bstod gong bzhin la/ las bzhi'i phrin las bsgrub la thogs med cing / /rnam 'phrul ma nges sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed/ /gdul bya'i re ba skong mdzad mkha' 'gro ma/ /sgyu ma'i gzugs can bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces sbyar/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las zhes pa nas/ nang du'i bar mchod pa bzhin las/ gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ sngags la/ i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hī khā hi btags pas phul/ mchod bstod gong bzhin/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la sogs kyis 'phrin las bcol/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa bya/ slob ma khrus byas gu gul gyis bdug gral la 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ chos bshad spyi dang yig rnying las 'byung ba'i lo rgyus bshad/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ 'od zer gyis lus sbyangs nas/ dzam+bha la gtso 'khor du bskyed/ ye shes dbab/ slob ma dzam+bha lar gsal ba la mchod bstod byas la/ dzaṃ dkar gyi sku spyi bor bzhag ste/

dus gsum bde gshegs sku yi mchog /sku dang ye shes rgyas pa'i sku/ /sku mchog 'di ni khyod kyis bzung / /lus kyi mi dge spang bar bya/ /sngags kyi mjug tu oṃ zhes brjod pas dbang bskur/ yang sku rgyan gyis tsaka li'i kyang lus la rgyan 'dogs tshul byas la/ sngags kyi mthar oṃ zhes brjod cing ster ba ni sku'i rigs gtad do/ /rang dang slob ma dzam+bha lar gsal ba'i snying khar sngags 'phreng bkod nas bzlas lung spyi 'gre byed pa gsung gi rigs gtad/ mdun bskyed dang slob ma'i gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsal btab nas mdun bskyed las yig 'bru gsum dang gtso 'khor lnga byon nas slob ma'i snying khar thim pas thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsams la/ slob ma'i lag g.yas su kha ṭ+wāṃ dang / g.yon du be con gtad nas/ rje btsun dzaṃ lha dkar po yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams/ /bu yis myur du thob par shog /gtso bo'i sngags brjod/ de bzhin du slob ma mkha' 'gro ma bzhir rim bzhin bskyed la g.yas g.yon du rdo rje dang rdzas snod gtad nas/ bcom ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sogs gong bzhin mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki ni pi sha ni/ lha klu'i srid pa thams cad bu 'di'i dbang du gyur cig swāhā/ yang rin po che dang bum pa gtad nas/ bcom ldan rin chen mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /sku sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki ni pi sha ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi nor rdzas thams cad bu 'di'i sogs/ yang pad+ma dang lcags kyu gtad la/ bcom ldan pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma'i sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki ni pi sha ni/ rgyal blon yul mi dbang chen nor bu sogs bu 'di'i sogs gong bzhin/ yang rgya gram dang ne'u le gtad la/ bcom ldan las kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ karma ḍā ki ni pi sha ni/

phyug po zas nor sna tshogs bu 'di'i sogs gong bzhin brjod pa ni lha bsgom pa dang / phyag mtshan gyi rjes gnang ngo / /gtor ma lha lngar gsal btab la/ brgyud pa'i mtshan nas brjod pa'i gtor dbang dkyus 'gre la/ lha lnga spyi bor thim par mos nas/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha dang slob ma'i spyi bor me tog bzhag pas brtan par byas la bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol/ gtso bo'i maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs spyi dang mthun/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ brtan bzhugs/ gshegs gsol/ gnas gsum bsrung / dge ba bsngo/ bkra shis rnams spyi ltar ro/ /brgyud pa ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ dpal ldan a ti sha rgyal ba brtson 'grus seng ge nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ po to ba rin chen gsal/ sha ra ba yon tan grags/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ spyan snga bsod nams 'phel/ bka' bcu ba gzhon nu seṅge/ srib ri ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ lha phub pa rin chen 'od zer/ bla ma dpal ldan don grub/ sangs rgyas 'od zer/ blo gros bzang po/ shākya bzang po/ spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang / spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ she'u lo tsā ba/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang / khyab bdag gnas gsar ba chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /zhes jo lugs kyi dzaṃ dkar lha lnga'i rjes gnang bya tshul khams gsum dbang sdud 'di yang sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros kyis rang dang skal mnyam la phan pa'i ched du bkod pa dge legs 'phel// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dzaṃ dkar rjes gnang khams gsum dbang sdud/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
